record.summary: Turn a green build branch into an open PR. The stage drives the target repo's own /ship discipline in a session rather than reimplementing the gate, treats PreToolUse hook exit-2 refusals as the first-class hook-blocked outcome, and verifies the result from the outside: PR exists, head sha matches the built branch, body carries no waiver unless a human approved one, and no session link or AI attribution appears anywhere.
record.title: Ship stage: commit, push, open the PR through the governed discipline
